headline: EU Imposes $4.2 Billion Sanctions Package on Russian Oil Exports
summary: European Union foreign ministers approved a fresh sanctions package targeting Russian oil exports worth approximately $4.2 billion, marking the bloc's 17th round of penalties since 2022. The measures restrict trading with five additional shipping firms and lower the price cap on Russian crude from $60 to $45 per barrel.
key_points: EU imposed an estimated $4.2 billion in new sanctions on Russian oil
The price cap on Russian crude drops from $60 to $45 per barrel
Five additional shipping firms were added to the sanctions list
European Council foreign affairs chief Kaja Kallas announced the measures in Brussels
